for p in ["exports/model.lid.6029fe16.stl","exports/model.base.87e59dfb.stl"]:

        mm=manifold3d.Manifold(mesh=manifold3d.Mesh(np.array(m.vertices,dtype=np.float32), np.array(m.faces,dtype=np.uint32)))
        print(" manifold status", mm.status, "vol", mm.volume, "genus", mm.genus)
    except Exception as e:
        print(" err", e)
    # self intersection?
    print(" euler", m.euler_number)
